title: Trusting the Tool: Asymmetric Deference of LLM Vulnerability Auditors to Static-Analysis Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.32876v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pipelines that combine large language models (LLMs) with static analysis let the model consume the analyser's output as evidence, but whether the model distinguishes true from false evidence, and whether its scrutiny depends on what the evidence claims, has not been measured. We built an intraprocedural analyser for C/C++ that produces proof obligations and audited vulnerable and patched functions from PrimeVul under six evidence conditions that differ only in the notes, including fabricated assurances that a missing check exists and fabricated alarms that an added check is missing. The study covers 916 pairs in four disjoint sets, eleven model configurations from four vendors and 16,572 audits; no model is trained or fine-tuned. True evidence barely improved accuracy (+0.02). False evidence acted asymmetrically: relative to true notes about the same operations, false assurances lowered the detection of real vulnerabilities by up to 19 p

translated_title: 信任工具：大语言模型漏洞审计员对静态分析证据的非对称盲从
translated_abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）与静态分析相结合的流水线允许模型将分析器的输出作为证据使用，但模型能否区分真实与虚假证据，以及其审查程度是否取决于证据所声称的内容，此前尚未被测量。我们构建了一个用于 C/C++ 的过程内分析器，它会生成证明义务，并在六种仅注释不同的证据条件下，对 PrimeVul 数据集中存在漏洞的函数与已修补的函数进行审计，其中包括虚假保证（谎称一个缺失的检查已存在）和虚假警报（谎称一个新增的检查缺失）。该研究涵盖四组互不相交集合中的 916 对函数、来自四家供应商的 11 种模型配置以及共 16,572 次审计；没有任何模型被训练或微调。真实证据几乎未能提升准确率（仅 +0.02）。虚假证据则表现出非对称性：相对于关于相同操作的真实注释，虚假保证使真实漏洞的检出率下降多达 19 个百分点。
tldr: 本研究首次量化了 LLM 漏洞审计员对静态分析证据的盲从性：真实证据几乎没有提升审计准确率，而工具的虚假“保证”却能使真实漏洞的检出率下降多达 19 个百分点，揭示了模型对工具证据的非对称依赖。
en_tdlr: This study quantifies LLM vulnerability auditors' asymmetric deference to static-analysis evidence: true evidence adds almost no accuracy, while the tool's fabricated assurances reduce detection of real vulnerabilities by up to 19 percentage points.
